name: manual_740a0a
claim: Never load a local model on the shared Mac to test something without all three: the model's size compared with the memory actually free, every earlier test or background run of your own confirmed finished, and the operator's explicit go for that load. A free-memory percentage that cannot hold the model is a stop, not a caveat.

decisions.notes: An agent loaded an 8.9 GB model on a 16 GB machine soon after reading about 42 percent free, without confirming its earlier test run had ended. The machine stopped responding, a watchdog panic followed and it rebooted within about three minutes. The crash report names no process, so the cause rests on timing and memory figures and is not proven.
